name: Attst
tagline: Every gram accounted for, every regulator satisfied.
positioning: Attst is the compliance backbone for multi-state cannabis operators — turning seed-to-sale chaos into audit-ready records across every jurisdiction you touch.

hero.h1: Compliance that keeps pace with every state you operate in.
hero.sub: Attst syncs your METRC tags, license renewals, and lab COAs into one living record — so a surprise audit becomes a five-minute export, not a five-day scramble.

features.title: METRC sync that never drifts
features.description: Reconcile package tags, transfers, and adjustments across every facility in real time. When a manifest and inventory disagree, Attst flags it before the state does.

features.title: One rule engine, every jurisdiction
features.description: Encode the possession limits, testing thresholds, and packaging rules for all 24 markets you serve. Attst applies the right ruleset per license automatically.

features.title: Audit-ready in one export
features.description: Every event carries an immutable timestamp, operator, and source document. Hand regulators a complete, tamper-evident trail without touching a spreadsheet.

features.title: License and renewal tracking
features.description: Track every state, local, and facility license with renewal windows, required filings, and owner sign-offs so nothing lapses mid-quarter.

features.title: Lab COA management
features.description: Attach certificates of analysis to the exact batches they cover and block non-compliant product from moving to the sales floor.

features.title: Real-time violation flags
features.description: Get alerted the moment a transfer, sale, or waste event breaks a rule — routed to the compliance lead who owns that facility.

testimonials.quote: Before Attst our compliance team spent the last week of every month reconciling METRC by hand. Now the discrepancies surface daily and we close them same-day. Our last state audit took two hours.
testimonials.name: Danielle Vasquez

testimonials.quote: We operate in nine states, and every one has its own testing and labeling quirks. Attst's rule engine means my facility managers stop guessing and my legal team stops sweating renewals.
testimonials.name: Marcus Adeyemi

testimonials.quote: The COA gating alone paid for itself. Product that fails potency limits physically can't move to sale now. That's the kind of control the board actually asks about.
testimonials.name: Priya Nathan
